title: Wren and the Orbit
author: Astrid Vasquez
blurb: Lena Whitlock, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
